certificates_catalog.name: Barangay Clearance
certificates_catalog.description: Official document certifying good moral character, residency, and no derogatory record in the barangay. Required for local employment, police clearance, and postal ID.
certificates_catalog.requirements: 1 Valid Government-Issued ID, Proof of Residency (Utility Bill or Lease Agreement)

certificates_catalog.name: Certificate of Residency
certificates_catalog.description: Proof of actual living residence in Cainta for government transactions, court appearances, banks, and utility applications.
certificates_catalog.requirements: 1 Valid ID with local address or Barangay Voter Certification

certificates_catalog.name: Certificate of Indigency
certificates_catalog.description: Issued to low-income and underprivileged residents for medical assistance (DSWD/PCSO), legal aid (PAO), educational scholarships, or funeral assistance.
certificates_catalog.requirements: Letter request stating specific purpose, Endorsement or Certificate of Low Income

certificates_catalog.name: Barangay Certification
certificates_catalog.description: General official certification for various legal or business requirements, lost documents, electric/water meter connection.
certificates_catalog.requirements: 1 Valid ID, Supporting Documents depending on specific purpose

certificates_catalog.name: Barangay Resident ID Card
certificates_catalog.description: Official laminated high-security photo ID recognized across Cainta establishments and local government transactions.
certificates_catalog.requirements: 1 Valid Photo ID, Proof of 6-month minimum residency

certificates_catalog.name: Barangay Business Clearance
certificates_catalog.description: Mandatory local clearance to secure a Mayor's Business Permit in Cainta for retail shops, sari-sari stores, and commercial offices.
certificates_catalog.requirements: DTI or SEC Registration, Contract of Lease or Land Title, Previous Year Business Permit

certificates_catalog.name: First Time Jobseeker Certificate (RA 11261)
certificates_catalog.description: Free official barangay document issued to first-time job applicants exempting them from government document fees under Republic Act 11261.
certificates_catalog.requirements: Barangay Oath of Undertaking, Valid School ID or Birth Certificate
